spec_match.rationale: The error table reproduces the explainer's Detailed API Behavior exactly — batch rejections (TypeError, SecurityError, NotSupportedError, NotAllowedError, QuotaExceededError, OperationError) vs per-path failedApps exceptions (ConstraintError, DataError, InvalidStateError, OperationError) — and the live attempt calls the real window.subApps.add.

interactive.rationale: The attempt button performs a genuine call (or the honest context-gate readout), and the produced outcome highlights its row in the table.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises a real call attempt plus the full error model with policy interactions; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes API-absent context, batch rejections, per-path failures, and documents which outcomes the v152 policies eliminate (NotAllowedError under silent-install policy).

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/6260680824061952; page cross-links v150 install-response-map and v153 batch-install to avoid overlap.

conformance.rationale: batch-prompt-decline and per-path-failures manual assertions in the suite mirror the table's contracts; the context-gate assertion runs live.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: attempt correctly reported the undefined-surface gate and highlighted the context row; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Separate asserts for context-gate, resolved, and batch-error branches with the error name recorded.

design_system.rationale: Highlighted row flips background AND color; table headers on stone; CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: Real table with caption and scoped headers; status is role=status aria-live; the highlight is redundant with the status text (not colour-only).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Wide table scrolls inside its own container; page body 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Exercise the real batch and per-path outcomes from an installed IWA
openQuestions.detail: In a normal tab only the context gate is reachable. From an installed IWA, verify the decline path (NotAllowedError), a mixed-path call (installedApps + failedApps), and that policy-exempted origins skip the prompt entirely.

guidanceConsulted.query: data table semantics scope caption screen reader
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Comparison/reference tables need real table semantics and text-borne state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Native table with caption + scoped headers; the produced outcome is announced in the aria-live status line as well as highlighted.

guidanceConsulted.query: wide reference table mobile scroll container
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Own horizontal scrolling in a wrapper.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: .err-table-wrap is overflow-x:auto; verified 0px page overflow at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the live attempt correctly hits the [IsolatedContext] gate on Chromium 141, highlights the matching table row, and keeps the console clean at both viewports. The in-IWA outcomes are honestly deferred to the manual conformance assertions and the open question.
